[b]Metropolis harbour[/b]
[u]4.21 am[/u]

gunshots fire from the security guards at the harbour as 20 to 40 armed people storm into the area where the coast guards ships were stationed. They stole one and returned fire from the water.

According to the official report from the police, they headed east with the ship and were pursued by the coast guard but the escaped. It is unclear what caused this incident and what the motive was. 

2 days earlier a private boat had been spotted driving in the similar direction. It looked like a transport vessel and did not respond to repeated calls from the coast guard. A drone with an infrared camera spotted up to 250 armed people on the ship. 

The events are worrying and are being investigated by the authorities.

[quote=tirakan;61031568][i][b]Proposition of a formal alliance to [nation]Valddera[/nation] - TV Ad break News - Naerim, Tirakan[/b][/i]

[i]*a quick intro signal the beginning of the ad-break-breaking-news-programm*[/i]

Shortly after Premier Arlan Vos re-election victory speech, the Tiraki government confirmed that it has formally stated its intention to declare a strategic alliance with Valddera, based on common goals and shared culture. Officials stated that Tirakan views Valddera as a natural partner in the region and is now awaiting a response from Valddera's government. Later the same day, Premier Vos addressed reporters questions in the Golden Office.

[i]*a video of Arlan Vos sitting in the Golden Office next to the Minister of Foreign Affairs blends in*[/i]

"Look, people ask me all the time, why Valddera? And it's a fair question. A very fair question. But the answer is actually very simple.
Valddera and Tirakan think alike. We do. We really do. Politically, culturally, strategically, theres alignment there, real alignment. We both believe in sovereignty. We both believe in stability. We both believe that our region should be shaped by the people who live here, not by distant powers who show up when it suits them and disappear when it doesn't.
Culturally, there's a lot of respect. There's a lot of history. There's a lot of understanding. You don't build alliances on paper, you build them on shared heart. And Valddera has that heart. They understand order, they understand responsibility, and the need to protect what your home.
Internationally, our interests overlap in a very big way. Security in the Shamat Sea. Security on East Shamat. Security beyond our region. Trade routes that stay open. Terrorism that gets confronted, not excused. Economic growth that actually benefits our people instead of draining them. On all of that, all of it, we're on the same page. We've seen it. We've seen it many times actually.
We respect Valddera as an equal. We respect their decisions, their leadership. And we think a formal alliance would bring stability, predictability, a lot of that, yes, and strength to the entire region. A lot of strength. Frankly, it's the kind of alliance that benefits the people, and those are the best ones.
So yes, we've made our position clear. The door is open. The offer is serious. And we expect a serious response. Because when Tirakan extends its hand, when it sees long-term value. And Valddera? That value is absolutely there."

[i]*the video fades out again*[/i]

And with that, the focus now shifts from speeches to responses. Tirakan has made its intentions clear, and the coming days will show whether Valddera is ready to match that momentum. Experts say, what follows could be the beginning of a new power structure on East Shamat. For now, the questions remain open, and the answers are expected soon. Thank you for tuning in with us!

[i]*a short outro ends the program and ads cut in*[/i][/quote]

[b]Valddera's Ministry of Foreign Affairs - Statement on Tirakan's Alliance and island Proposal[/b]

[i]Naerim, Valddera - Following the Republic of Tirakans public proposal for a strategic alliance and expressed interest in purchasing and negotiation of the two isles near Tirakans maritime borders, the Valdderan government has issued the following statement:[/i]

"The Government of Valddera warmly acknowledges the Republic of Tirakans initiative to strengthen ties through a formal strategic alliance. We recognize the shared strategic interests, cultural connections, and commitment to regional stability that both our nations uphold.

Valddera welcomes the opportunity to explore closer cooperation with Tirakan in areas including security, trade, and regional stability. Our nations share principles of sovereignty, respect for the rule of law, and a dedication to the prosperity of our peoples. We are confident that careful diplomatic dialogue can define the scope, objectives, and terms of a potential alliance that benefits both nations and the wider East Shamat region.

Regarding the proposal concerning the two isles near Tirakans maritime borders, Valddera appreciates Tirakans interest in responsible development and partnership. While these territories remain under Valdderan sovereignty, we are open to discussing mutually beneficial agreements, so far Tirakan's only bid was a 10 billion deal for the isles which seems reasonable enough, but Valddera requests the Tiraki Government to be more specific on what agreements will be fully agreed on. Any such arrangements will respect our national laws, territorial integrity, and the well-being of our citizens.

The government looks forward to engaging Tirakan in constructive discussions to explore options that promote shared prosperity while safeguarding the rights and sovereignty of all parties. Valddera remains committed to dialogue, confident that cooperation based on trust and mutual respect will strengthen both nations and the stability of East Shamat."

[b]Reconstruction+Expansion[/b]

[spoiler=Reconstruction][i]When the aftermath of the Civil War arose, the Intern Government was tasked with a lot. The main priorities were Reconstruction to rebuild from the devastating war. Many plans were discussed among them, and while there were disagreements, compromise was reached with the goals of rebuilding. One of the first notable actions was the seizure of the wealth once held by the Royal Family. The wealth sized would be put into a new welfare system known as the Sovereign Aid and Industry Fund(SAIF). Through SAIF, Nevonians in need would receive a monthly check, with those living in poverty, disabled, elderly, and single parents receiving more. Under the previous royalist regime, multi-billion krona businesses controlled massive amounts of wealth, often failing to do the purposes they serve. All of the top 15 corporations were nationalized, with some of their wealth seized and redistributed to smaller and family-owned businesses. The newly nationalized corporations and industries would be put under government control to ensure the public receives services properly.[/i][/spoiler]

[spoiler=expansion][i]The Intern Government also had another priority in mind, and that was accountability for those involved with the royalist regime and those who committed atrocities against innocent people. Thousands of soldiers who served the royalist armed forces were arrested and faced trials. While a lot of soldiers were not found to have committed atrocities on purpose and given light punishments, however, top military officials and soldiers who committed war crimes were not given the same mercy. While some of the people wanted for war crimes surrendered or turned themselves in, many did not. An order given by the Intern Government ordered the Nasjonale Boargerlike Plysje to search across Nevonia for suspected war criminals hiding. A lot of high-level individuals were found after the arrest of one of the top commanders. It was revealed that many people suspected of war crimes had fled the country after the war. Nearby Nevonia, shortly off the coast into the sea, were a few islands that were not Nevonian territory. Inside the Intern Government, discussions were going on about potentially expanding into those islands in search of war criminals and preventing the islands from falling into dark hands. The discussions became more serious, and a decision of expansion was made; it would be done. On a spring morning on the northern coast, thousands of Nevonyske selsferdigeningsmachten (NSDM) soldiers began preparing. A task force was assembled that would be made up of about 13,200 Nasjonaal Republikeinsk Leger (NRL) soldiers, 6,600 sailors of the Nasjonale Republikeinske Marine (NRM), and a small number of pilots and bombers of the Nasjonale Republikeinske Loftmachtt (NRLM). On a beach near Maaiefjild, Intern Minister of Defense Tide Ykema made an address speaking of the upcoming expedition. [/i]

[b]Intern Minister of Defense Tide Ykema:[/b][i]"Goeiemoarn, today we are about to launch an expedition to bring true accountability. The northern islands, not too far away, are hiding the criminals behind the murder of innocent of our people. Justice will happen whether they like it or not. With that in mind, I am announcing Operation Belje Gewoan. The task force assembled is made up of men and women who are ready to fight to bring justice for our people. The mission is to arrest those who are wanted for war crimes as well to prevent the islands slipping into of darker forces."[/i]

[i]Shortly after Ykema's speech, the Task Force set sail and began Operation Belje Gewoan. Not that long after making their way, the task force arrived at the islands. The first units stormed the shores and launched a searching campaign. The population of the islands was very small at around 25,000-30,000 but the NSDM was prepared for any resistance. The task force had not seen anyone yet but had started efforts to capture the wanted war criminals. As well accompying the soldiers were officers of the Nasjonale Boargerlike Plysje (NBP) or National Civil Police. On the islands the task force and officers brought along search dogs and yelled through loudspeakers. Eventually out of a cave a group of around 25 men appeared and surrendered themselves. The men were interogated on a navak ship with all of them admitting to have fought in the war and fleeing to the islands afterwards as well some of them admitted to have been involved in numures atrocities. While 1 group of men had been arrested, it was obvious that were was more on the islands with trash and kayaks found. Soldiers had fired warning shots in the air in an attempt to scare anyone hiding and make them appear and the tactic worked with more and more men surrendering themselves. Soon after the the NRL discovered a village that was inhabited by locals. The locals seemed to not care about the NRL posed no threat to the operation. Across the islands more hidden suspected war criminals were found but the most notable would soon be caught. While some officers and the NRL were going through a valley they heard a gunshot, then more shots rang out. Soon a few guys who shot at the unit were surrounded. It seemed as they were guarding something or someone and that was correct. Hiding in a foresty cave, they found Kommandant Gribbert Post who was directly responsible for the use of chemical weapons and was the one who proposed the idea of using them. Kommandant Post did not surrender instead he shot back but after being shot in the arm he surrendered. Post was arrested and taken back to the Nevonian mainland charged with war crimes, murder, torture, killing of innocent civilians and crimes against humanity. Even with Post captured there was most likely more hiding so along with that and the need of the islands for national security the islands were declared a territory of Nevonia. The islands inhabitants spoke a much different language than Nevonian, called Colanskian. The islands were officially declared as the Northern Coastal Outerlands and the Nevonian Intern Government would began building new infanstructure on the islands.[/i][/spoiler]
